review: gfx1250 HSA ordinary GLOBAL B32 byte alignment

feature_chain.fact: GFX12 has UnalignedBufferAccess, UnalignedScratchAccess, and UnalignedDSAccess
AMDHSA OS enables unaligned-access-mode by default
Buffer and DS enabled predicates require capability AND unaligned access mode
Extended GLOBAL accepts access below DWORD alignment when the unaligned-buffer predicate is enabled

scope_distinctions.SMEM: GLOBAL byte addressing is independent of SMEM component masking. Scalar loads use the width-specific component masks specified by the public CDNA5 ISA section 8.1.1.
scope_distinctions.DS: Separate capability and opcode-specific width/offset/hardware-bug checks exist in SIISelLowering lines2042-2148; this review proposes no DS model expansion.
scope_distinctions.FLAT: Separate path in SIISelLowering lines2150-2164 conservatively treats unknown aperture as potentially scratch. This review proposes no FLAT model expansion.
scope_distinctions.buffer: Buffer-fat/resource robust-OOB path lines2176-2188 has its own conditions and cannot be inferred from ordinary GLOBAL.

modeled_profile.bounds: Entire four-byte transfer must fit one configured array or module object before any component effect. Initialized-byte definedness and read-only checks remain unchanged.
modeled_profile.data: Only already modeled raw byte/half/word representations may be transported; underalignment does not decode arbitrary symbolic word subparts.
